logic_errors.issue: Missing copy receipts silently become zero-byte measurements. The analyzer accepts incomplete traces containing convolution.gpu without copy spans; the plot then reports zero uploads/readbacks. Missing candidate kernel_bytes likewise becomes zero.
logic_errors.minimal_fix: Require case-specific copy stages and candidate kernel_bytes. Permit zero defaults only for structurally absent operations, such as baseline fusion spans and its legacy kernel counter.

summary: All three previous root blockers are fixed; 14 targeted tests passed. Plot fields, seconds/GiB conversions, and sample selection match the declared campaign, apart from the missing-data issue above. Read-only review; no edits, builds, heavy tests, native execution, or plot rendering.
